reference.title: Scenario: graphical representation in a concept topic

section.p: Consider a "Using the Control Panel" chapter in a "Printer User Guide" document where you want to introduce the various buttons and indicators available on the printer control panel. There is an image of the control panel with callouts. Because the purpose of the topic is to explain the layout and components of the control panel rather than perform a procedure, use a graphical representation in a concept topic.
section.codeblock:
Using the Control Panel Learn about the control panel and the available control panel settings.

The control panel provides access to printer settings, status information, and maintenance functions.

Control Panel Buttons and Lights

The control panel contains the following components:

  1. Power button and light
  2. Home button
  3. LCD screen
  4. Help button
  5. Stop button
  6. Back button
  7. Arrow buttons and OK button
  8. Reset button
  9. Start button
